sections.title: Hotfix Patch
sections.description: This is a hotfix patch. All replay codes from the May 12th patch are still available.

general: Bonus Shot damage increased to 30% (up from 25%).
Ability Damage per 1% Fuel decreased to 7.5 (down from 10).

blocks.title: Stadium
blocks.body: Fixed an issue where Jetpack Cat's Bell Bomb would stay active when the Power was unequipped. Fixed an issue where Juno's Glide Boost cooldown would reset to 0 permanently when using Refresher and Red Promise Regulator.
